condition_entries.name: Pyometra (uterine infection)

red_flags.description: Any of the symptoms above occurring within roughly 2-8 weeks of a heat cycle
Closed pyometra (no visible discharge) with lethargy, vomiting, or a distended abdomen

condition_entries.prevention_tips: Spaying removes the uterus entirely and eliminates this risk completely.

condition_entries.name: Mammary tumors
condition_entries.prevention_tips: Discuss spay timing and individual risk factors with your vet rather than relying on a fixed default age.

condition_entries.name: Testicular tumor and cryptorchidism risk

red_flags.description: Sudden severe scrotal pain or swelling

condition_entries.prevention_tips: Discuss retained testicles and neutering with your vet.

condition_entries.name: Prostatic disease
condition_entries.prevention_tips: Discuss urinary or reproductive changes in an intact male with your vet.
sources: REVIEW REQUIRED: replace with a primary clinical or guideline source before shipping

condition_entries.name: Straining to urinate / urethral obstruction

red_flags.description: Straining with little or no urine produced in a neutered male cat
Lethargy, vomiting, or collapse on top of straining

condition_entries.prevention_tips: Multiple clean litter trays, wet food, a lean body condition, and reducing multi-cat stress can lower recurrence risk.

condition_entries.name: Estrogen-responsive urinary incontinence

red_flags.description: Blood in urine, straining, fever, or pain alongside leaking

condition_entries.prevention_tips: This cannot be fully prevented and is a recognized trade-off of spaying in some female dogs.

preventive_care_items.title: Recalculate diet after spaying or neutering
preventive_care_items.description: Reassess calorie needs and body condition after neutering, then continue regular weight checks.

preventive_care_items.title: Discuss neuter timing for large-breed puppies
preventive_care_items.description: For dogs expected to exceed roughly 20kg, discuss breed-specific timing with your vet rather than following a fixed default age.

preventive_care_items.title: Confirm both testicles have descended by 6 months
preventive_care_items.description: Ask your vet to check testicular descent at the puppy's routine visit and discuss next steps if one has not descended.

preventive_care_items.title: Discuss spay timing before the first heat
preventive_care_items.description: Discuss individual timing with your vet, especially for large-breed female dogs where risks and benefits can differ.
preventive_care_items.recurrence: one-time discussion before the first heat
